poster.purpose: Every h1. Anton caps at clamp(44px, 7.4vw, 112px), weight 400, printed in the sheet's own ink with the second ink shadowed off register.

poster-sm.purpose: Section h2s and closing statement lines. Anton caps at clamp(30px, 4vw, 56px), same off-register treatment.

display.purpose: Rare use above the h1 step. Newsreader 400 at clamp(46px, 5.6vw, 74px).

lead.purpose: Standfirsts and pull quotes. Body face at clamp(19px, 2vw, 22px).

body.purpose: Reading copy. Archivo (standing in for Helvetica Neue) at clamp(15px, 1.4vw, 16px), line-height 1.65.

label.purpose: Kickers, meta rows, table headings. Fixed 11px uppercase, +0.08em tracking, weight 400 only, the fixed size in the whole scale.

mono.purpose: Readouts and tabular data. Fragment Mono, weight 400 only, tabular numerals.

script.purpose: The single footer wordmark. Great Vibes standing in for Snell Roundhand, used exactly once per page.

shadows.name: offset
shadows.purpose: The one shadow the system allows: a printed plate, thumbnail, or panel sitting on a hard offset in the sheet's second ink.

shadows.name: offset-button
shadows.purpose: The tighter offset on .c97-btn, .c97-btn-invert, and .c97-btn-outline. Collapses to none and the button shifts 4px on press.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Solid rectangle, no radius. Ink-2 fill with surface text; hover darkens to ink. Offset variant adds a 4px hard shadow in the sheet's second ink that collapses on press.
components.css: .c97-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 32px); border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #4a3728; color: #f1ebdf; font-size: clamp(13px, 1.3vw, 15px); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .c97-btn:hover { background: #2b211a; } .c97-btn.c97-offset { box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--c97-overprint); transition: box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .c97-btn.c97-offset:active { box-shadow: none; transform: translate(4px, 4px); }

components.name: Invert button
components.description: Swaps to full ink for use on a saffron or vermilion band, where the primary button's ink-2 fill would sit too close to the band's own ink.

components.name: Outline button
components.description: The outlined display button, used once, on a route's closing vermilion band, set at the h2 step to match the closing line beside it.
components.css: .c97-btn-outline { min-height: 64px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 32px); border: 2px solid #2b211a; background: none; color: #2b211a; font-size: clamp(24px, 2.7vw, 32px); line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .c97-btn-outline:hover { background: #2b211a; color: #f1ebdf; }

components.name: Printed panel
components.description: A raised block, drawer, or sidebar. Elevation is a surface change here, so a panel is a flat tint of its sheet with no border, no radius, and no shadow.

components.name: Field
components.description: A pale tint of the sheet with a bottom rule instead of a full border, and no radius. Focus shifts the accent in; there is no glow.
components.css: .c97-field { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #4a3728; border-radius: 0; padding: 0 clamp(12px, 1.3vw, 17px); background: #e4dbc9; color: #2b211a; font-size: clamp(15px, 1.4vw, 16px); width: 100%; }

components.name: Tag chip
components.description: A status or category tag. Label-step uppercase on the field tint, no radius. On several ink surfaces the status tones cannot clear 4.5:1 at body size, so the tone shows through ink instead.
components.css: .c97-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(8px, 0.9vw, 10px); min-height: 28px; padding: 0 clamp(12px, 1.3vw, 17px); background: #e4dbc9; color: #2b211a; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Mono readout
components.description: The label, value, delta triplet that carries every measured figure on the site. The value is set in the body face at the h2 step, never Anton, which is kept for plate numerals and poster headlines.
components.css: .c97-stat { display: grid; gap: clamp(8px, 0.9vw, 10px); align-content: start; } .c97-stat-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #645e55; margin: 0; } .c97-stat-value { font-size: clamp(24px, 2.7vw, 32px); line-height: 1.2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #2b211a; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: Catalog 97 treats every page as a print run off a risograph press. A route is built from bands of grained paper stock, each one a sheet that can change color as the page scrolls, and a sheet that changes surface tears over the one above it in a rough torn or deckled edge. Two lead riso inks carry a page's identity, chosen from blue, saffron, vermilion, green, teal, and pink, with peach counting as a vermilion tint and not a seventh option. Display type is poster type, Anton caps for every h1 and section h2, printed in the sheet's own ink with the second ink shadowed a few hundredths of an em off register. Newsreader carries every other heading at weight 400 only, Archivo carries body copy, and Fragment Mono carries readouts and micro-labels at weight 400 only. The system draws no rounded corners and no blurred shadow; the one shadow it allows is the hard printed offset behind a plate, thumbnail, or button.
keyCharacteristics: Sheets of grained paper stock, not flat panels. Every surface tears over its neighbor when the surface changes.
Two lead riso inks per page, chosen from six plus a vermilion tint, never a third.
Anton poster caps on every h1 and section h2, shadowed off register in the page's second ink.
Newsreader at weight 400 for every other heading, and Archivo for body copy and kickers.
Zero radius and zero blurred shadow. The only shadow is the hard offset behind a printed plate, thumbnail, or button.
Fragment Mono at weight 400 only, with tabular numerals for anything measured or counted.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: A page picks exactly two lead riso inks from blue, saffron, vermilion, green, teal, and pink, with peach counting as a vermilion tint. A third lead ink is never introduced.

rules.name: The Surface Rule
rules.body: A component never sets a color directly. It sits inside a data-c97-surface and reads that surface's own --c97-ink, --c97-ink-2, --c97-label, --c97-action, --c97-accent, and --c97-rule, which is what makes the dark palette a single override per surface rather than a per-component edit.

rules.name: The Data-Color Rule
rules.body: Team liveries, transit line colors, and party colors stay data and never become inks. A route whose data already speaks in blue and red, for instance, prints its own two lead inks in neither, and because those colors used as small text routinely fail 4.5:1, the color goes on a swatch or a mark while the label text prints in the surface's own ink.

rules.name: The Poster Rule
rules.body: Anton caps carry every h1 and every section h2 or closing statement, printed in the sheet's own ink with the second ink cast as a text-shadow off register. Project and article titles stay in Newsreader because they name a specific thing.

rules.name: The Honest Weight Rule
rules.body: Fragment Mono ships at weight 400 only, and Newsreader never bolds. Anton draws numerals at the plate size only, never running text.

rules.name: The No-Radius Rule
rules.body: tailwind.config.ts compiles every step of the radius scale and the shadow scale to nothing. The one shape exception is the radio input, which sets border-radius: 50% so it renders as a circle. The one shadow exception is the hard printed offset, .c97-offset.

rules.name: The Ladder Rule
rules.body: Nothing in a Catalog 97 route uses a gap, margin, or band padding that is not one of the seven --c97-sp steps, and nothing is added to the frozen type or measure scales.

dos: Set data-c97-surface on the section and read var(--c97-ink), var(--c97-ink-2), var(--c97-label), var(--c97-action), var(--c97-accent), and var(--c97-rule) inside it.
Keep every gap, margin, and band padding on the --c97-sp-1 through --c97-sp-7 ladder.
Keep radii at zero everywhere outside the one sanctioned identity exception (/arcade), and let the one hard .c97-offset shadow stand in for every other shadow.
Keep Fragment Mono at weight 400 and set tabular numerals on anything measured or counted.
Keep Newsreader at weight 400, and reserve Anton poster type for h1s, section h2s, and closing statements.
Confirm a status color clears 4.5:1 as body-size text on its surface before shipping it that way; several surfaces are large-text-or-mark only and fall back to ink.
Keep a project's data colors, liveries, line colors, and party colors, as data, never as an ink.
donts: Don't hardcode a hex in a component; read the token for the surface the component sits inside.
Don't round a corner or add a blurred shadow anywhere outside /arcade, the one sanctioned exception.
Don't fake a bold Fragment Mono weight, and don't bold Newsreader.
Don't give a print run a third lead ink. A page picks exactly two, and peach counts as a vermilion tint, not a seventh ink.

Don't read a --home-*, --surface-*, --text-*, --border-*, --color-*, --radius-*, or --shadow-* token, and don't reach for HomeStatsPanel, WarmCard, Badge, Chip, Kicker, SectionIntro, Heading, Paragraph, or InlineSectionLead; all were deleted with the Working Instrument on 2026-09-27.
